author: Yffe
content: SHIPPED + critic-clean (3c27d68). The item_subprogram already weaves the partner (fn_deps) so Verus sees the SCC — no lower.rs change. Critic NO DIVERGENCE (R-DEFER-9): dec'd pair/3-cycle -> L3 (termination genuinely proven), non-decreasing/n+1/bad-edge -> L0, any-no-dec -> clean whole-cycle L0 (no VIR crash), diverge -> L1, the partner woven (wrong is_odd -> is_even also L0, not laundered), no cheat. 652 tests. Single-fn recursion unchanged.
